claim.quote: TeV gamma ray emission was detected at the 5 sigma level, and a flux of (5.8 +- 1.2(stat) +- 1.2(syst)) 10^(-9) ph m^(-2) s^(-1) above 1 TeV was derived.

name: HEGRA finds evidence for TeV gamma rays from Cassiopeia A

significance.quote: TeV gamma ray emission was detected at the 5 sigma level

summary.plain: After 232 hours of observation, HEGRA's stereoscopic telescopes detected TeV gamma rays from the supernova remnant Cassiopeia A at the 5 sigma level, the first TeV source reported on the "centi-Crab" scale, about a hundredth of the Crab's brightness.
summary.technical: 232 hours of HEGRA stereoscopic IACT data (1997-1999): TeV emission detected at 5 sigma, flux (5.8 +- 1.2 stat +- 1.2 syst) x 10^-9 ph m^-2 s^-1 above 1 TeV, differential index -2.5 +- 0.4 stat +- 0.1 syst between 1 and 10 TeV.

title: Evidence for TeV gamma ray emission from Cassiopeia A
why_it_matters: The abstract says this is the first report of the detection of a TeV gamma-ray source on the "centi-Crab" scale.
